name: agapay
description: Calamity relief donation and distribution system

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agapay/shared && npm run build -w @agapay/api && npm run build -w @agapay/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @agapay/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @agapay/shared && npm run typecheck -w @agapay/shared && npm run typecheck -w @agapay/api && npm run typecheck -w @agapay/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agapay/shared && npm run test -w @agapay/api && npm run test -w @agapay/web
scripts.test:e2e: echo "TODO(M7): Playwright not scaffolded yet" && exit 0
